title: The Living Embodiment of Romance
summary: The creed at the heart of the Hollow Ones.

claims.text: Hollow Ones insist their way is not a club but a living expression of Romance, and a newcomer swears to embody it.
They claim ancestry back to the early Middle Ages with some confidence, though records of earlier kindred spirits are unclear.
Not every Hollow One is strictly goth; their tone runs from deep despair to bold swagger, joined by a romantic, heroic, larger-than-life outlook that finds beauty in horror.

title: The first Hollow vanguards
summary: How the modern Hollow tradition came together.

claims.text: Six Awakened intellectuals filled with romance met near the end of the First World War and pooled ideas on art, rights, love, misery and Ascension.
They decided that open eyes bring a duty to keep dreams, myth and romance from ever going out of style.
Some of those founders still live, past 75 yet looking young through magic.

title: Councilors and Revolutionaries
summary: The two main camps among the Hollow Ones.

claims.text: Each Hollower picks a personal style or fad, and while it lasts that choice binds the mage's magic as firmly as any Tradition's ways.
Nearly all agree the Technocracy is awful and that Marauder and Nephandic visions of reality are unacceptable.
Councilors see the Council of Nine as the least bad option and hope to teach the old Traditions ways to avoid fading into the past.

title: Hollow Ones, vampires and fae
summary: How Hollowers deal with the other night-dwellers.

claims.text: Some young Hollowers learn a few tricks useful to vampires and set off for big cities to find an undead friend; most are never seen again.
A few survive for a while as a prized mage in the pocket of some old elder.
Fae love dream-minded mages, and Hollow Ones taken into the Dreaming often do not want to return, since it is nearly everything they wish the world were.
The idea that all goths want to be vampires may once have fit part of the tradition, but it fits less and less.

title: The Hollow Railroad
summary: The Hollow Ones' network for passing word.

claims.text: Cells pass news by graffiti, symbols and post, both paper and electronic.
Mind adepts receive messages in dreams, spirit-sensitive members hear from ghosts, and Time and Correspondence users scry far-off events.
Gaunts gather what ghosts have seen, and narcoleptic members share knowledge through staged dream dramas.

title: Putting on your face
summary: Makeup and dress as a focus for subtle Mind magic.

claims.text: Striking makeup and clothing often serve as foci for quiet Mind Effects such as Empathic Projection and Psychic Impression.
Such uses of Mind are mostly coincidental.
Dressing up is also a ritual for steadying the mind before facing a situation.

title: Hollow Ones and the Technocracy
summary: Why Hollowers see their life as revolt.

claims.text: Hollow Ones cast Technocrats as heartless and unimaginative, jealous of anyone who can feel and say what they feel.
Living by inner passion instead of imposed norms is, to them, a daily act of resistance against a world turned into an assembly line.
